title: Riesz vector of the wedge functional w ↦ ζ₀(w^♭∧α)
statement: Let P, d ∈ ℕ, ζ₀ ∈ Λ_{d+1}(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P (d+1), a continuous linear functional on (d+1)-covectors) and α a d-covector on ℝ^P. Then there is a vector v ∈ ℝ^P such that for every w ∈ ℝ^P and every (d+1)-covector γ with γ(u_0, …, u_d) = Σ_{i=0}^{d} (−1)^i⟨w, u_i⟩α(u_0, …, û_i, …, u_d) for all u (û_i omitted, i.e. α(Fin.removeNth i u)), one has ζ₀(γ) = ⟨v, w⟩. (Such a γ is w^♭∧α; v is the Riesz representative of the linear functional w ↦ ζ₀(w^♭∧α).)
lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (ζ₀ : MultiVector P (d + 1)) (α : Covector (Euclid P) d), ∃ v : Euclid P, ∀ (w : Euclid P) (γ : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1)), (∀ u : Fin (d + 1) → Euclid P, γ u = ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i : ℕ) * (inner ℝ w (u i) * α (i.removeNth u))) → ζ₀ γ = inner ℝ v w
